aiTools.name: GitHub Copilot
aiTools.description: AI pair programmer deeply integrated into VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim with inline suggestions, multi-file edits, and GitHub PR code review.

aiTools.name: Windsurf
aiTools.description: Next-generation AI code editor from Codeium with Cascade agentic flows, deep codebase awareness, and real-time collaborative coding features.

aiTools.name: Cline
aiTools.description: Open-source autonomous AI coding agent for VS Code that reads files, runs commands, and edits code end-to-end with full terminal access.

aiTools.description: Open-source AI code assistant for VS Code and JetBrains with any LLM backend, custom context providers, and privacy-first local model support.

aiTools.name: Codeium
aiTools.description: Free AI coding assistant with unlimited inline completions, chat, and search across 70+ programming languages and all major IDEs.

aiTools.name: Tabnine
aiTools.description: AI coding assistant with strong privacy focus, on-premise deployment option, team learning from private codebase, and enterprise compliance.
